note: BH-6459: 1 = the builder's impact gate runs the whole-repo suites (the always list plus the learned `*` rows) on HEAD merged with a fresh fetch of origin's main, not on HEAD. A ratchet can be green on HEAD and on main and red on their merge. HARNESS_IMPACT_GATE_RUN passes it to the gate as an env value. A gate run outside the builder (CI, a Mac) does not read this row and stays off.
